title: 'When you're that sick, you reflect on the values that matter most': Sweden's Birgitta Ohlsson returns to fight the far right
subhed: The former Liberal figure, who had left politics, is now standing with the Center Party in Sweden's general election on Sunday. At 51, after fighting two cancers, the pro-European feminist is determined to take on the extremist drift of her former political camp.

title: 'Ordinary citizens do not want to be sent to a war with no end in sight': Russian men consider exile
subhed: Amid the threat of renewed conscription, some Russian men of fighting age have purchased plane tickets and are ready to leave if a general mobilization is declared after the elections scheduled for September 18 to 20. Georgia, Armenia and Serbia are the most popular destinations.

title: In southeast France, the deaths of 64 sheep blamed on wolves raise questions
subhed: French wildlife officials say wolves are responsible for a particularly deadly attack in a pasture in the Drôme department in late August. Advocacy groups dispute that assessment, at a time when shootings of wild canid are on the rise.
